01 / GYM

The gym

Kalasag is a coached strength gym in Davao City — the opposite of a treadmill warehouse you pay for and never use.

"Kalasag" means shield. That's the idea: strength you build here is armour for everything else — a body that carries the groceries, plays with the kids and holds up under a long week. Every class is programmed and coached, so you're taught the lifts properly and pushed at exactly the right amount.

Beginners are the whole point. Most members walked in never having touched a barbell. You start where you are, a coach scales the work to you, and the community drags you back on the days you'd rather skip.

07 / FAQ

Before you start

Total beginner — is this for me? +
Yes — most people who walk in have never touched a barbell. Every session is coached and scaled to you, so you start where you are and build from there. Beginners are the point, not the exception.
How does a free trial work? +
Message us and we'll book you into a coached class or an intro session. You train, meet the coaches, see the floor, and decide with no pressure and nothing to sign on the day.
Do I need to be fit before I start? +
No. Getting fit is the job of the gym, not a requirement to join. Coaches adjust every movement to your current strength and mobility, whatever that is today.
Are sessions coached or self-guided? +
Group classes are led by a coach who teaches, corrects and scales the work. There's also open-gym time and one-to-one personal coaching if you want closer guidance.
What should I bring? +
Training clothes, trainers, a towel and a water bottle. That's it — the equipment and the plan are ours to provide.
Boxing and conditioning too, or just weights? +
Both. Alongside barbell strength work we run conditioning classes and coached boxing, so you can train for strength, engine or skill — or mix all three.
